# sampling.SamplingFrame { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame }

```python
SamplingFrame(
    blocklens=None,
    tr=None,
    start_time=None,
    precision=0.1,
    *,
    n_scans=None,
    TR=None,
)
```

fMRI acquisition timing specification.

A frame records scan counts, repetition times, and per-run acquisition
offsets. Scalar timing inputs are repeated across runs.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Default   |
|------------|------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| blocklens  | int or array-like of int     | Number of scans in each run. Use ``n_scans`` as the compatibility alias.                                                                                                                                                                                | `None`    |
| tr         | float or array-like of float | Repetition time in seconds for each run. Use ``TR`` as the compatibility alias.                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`    |
| start_time | float or array-like of float | Acquisition offset in seconds for each run. Defaults to half the corresponding TR.                                                                                                                                                                      | `None`    |
| precision  | float                        | Fine-grid step stored with the frame. This value is not automatically shared with HRF/regressor evaluation (default 0.33 s) or design construction (default ``min(TR) / 16``). Pass an explicit precision when two computations must use the same grid. | `0.1`     |
| n_scans    | int or array-like of int     | Compatibility alias for ``blocklens``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `None`    |
| TR         | float or array-like of float | Compatibility alias for ``tr``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `None`    |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `TR` | Repetition time (scalar, for backward compatibility). |
| `acquisition_onsets` | Get fMRI acquisition onset times. |
| `blockids` | Block ID for each scan. |
| `global_scan_times` | Global scan times across all blocks. |
| `n_blocks` | Number of blocks. |
| `n_scans` | Total number of scans across all blocks. |
| `samples` | Time points for each scan. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [block_samples](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.block_samples) | Get time points for a specific block. |
| [concatenate](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.concatenate) | Concatenate two sampling frames. |
| [from_dict](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.from_dict) | Create SamplingFrame from dictionary. |
| [global_onsets](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.global_onsets) | Convert block-relative onset times to global (experiment-wide) onset times. |
| [run_ids](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.run_ids) | Return the run/block id for each scan. |
| [sample_times](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.sample_times) | Get time points for scans with optional filtering. |
| [to_dict](#fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.to_dict) | Convert to dictionary representation. |

### block_samples { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.block_samples }

```python
block_samples(block_idx)
```

Get time points for a specific block.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description           | Default    |
|-----------|--------|-----------------------|------------|
| block_idx | int    | Zero-based run index. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                  | Description                                |
|--------|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------|
|        | NDArray\[np.float64\] | Run-relative acquisition times in seconds. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                            |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If ``block_idx`` is outside the frame. |

### concatenate { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.concatenate }

```python
concatenate(other)
```

Concatenate two sampling frames.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type          | Description                    | Default    |
|--------|---------------|--------------------------------|------------|
| other  | SamplingFrame | Frame appended after this one. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                   |
|--------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | SamplingFrame | New frame with both sets of runs and adjusted global offsets. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                   |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If the frames use different precision values. |

### from_dict { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.from_dict }

```python
from_dict(data)
```

Create SamplingFrame from dictionary.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                                                                 | Default    |
|--------|------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| data   | dict\[str, Any\] | Mapping containing ``blocklens`` plus ``tr`` or ``TR``; optional keys are ``start_time`` and ``precision``. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                     |
|--------|---------------|-------------------------------------------------|
|        | SamplingFrame | Validated frame reconstructed from the mapping. |

### global_onsets { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.global_onsets }

```python
global_onsets(onsets, blockids)
```

Convert block-relative onset times to global (experiment-wide) onset times.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type              | Description                                | Default    |
|----------|-------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| onsets   | array - like      | Times relative to the start of their runs. | _required_ |
| blockids | array-like of int | Zero-based run ID for each onset.          | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                  | Description                  |
|--------|-----------------------|------------------------------|
|        | NDArray\[np.float64\] | Experiment-wide onset times. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                         |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If the inputs have different lengths or a block ID is out of range. |

### run_ids { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.run_ids }

```python
run_ids(one_based=False)
```

Return the run/block id for each scan.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description                                                                                              | Default   |
|-----------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| one_based | bool   | If ``True``, return R-compatible 1-based run ids. The canonical internal representation remains 0-based. | `False`   |

### sample_times { #fmrimod.sampling.SamplingFrame.sample_times }

```python
sample_times(global_time=True, blockids=None)
```

Get time points for scans with optional filtering.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type              | Description                                                                                                | Default   |
|-------------|-------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| global_time | bool              | Return experiment-wide times when true; otherwise return times relative to the start of each selected run. | `True`    |
| blockids    | array-like of int | Zero-based run IDs to include.                                                                             | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                  | Description                                         |
|--------|-----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | NDArray\[np.float64\] | Acquisition times in seconds for the selected runs. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                   |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | ValueError | If a requested block ID is outside the frame. |
